meta.name: Send keyword-based Hacker News Slack alerts with Groq and Google Sheets

name: HN Keyword Monitor — AI-Summarized Slack Alerts

parameters.content:
## HN Keyword Monitor — AI-Summarized Slack Alerts

### How it works

This workflow runs every two hours to search Hacker News for configured keywords, normalize the results, and compare them against a Google Sheets log of already-seen URLs. New posts are summarized with Groq and sent to Slack, then recorded back to Google Sheets so they are not alerted again.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule interval in the When Every 2 Hours trigger if needed.
- Update the Config node with the keywords to monitor, the Slack webhook URL, and the Google Sheet ID.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and ensure the sheet has the expected columns for storing seen post URLs.
- Add the Groq API authorization details to the Summarize With Groq HTTP request.
- Verify the Slack webhook accepts the payload sent by the Notify: Slack node.
- Keep your keyword list reasonably short (5-10 is plenty) — each keyword runs its own Hacker News search per poll, and this hits a shared public API with no key.

### Customization

Adjust the keyword list, Hacker News search query construction, summary prompt/model, Slack message format, or deduplication fields to match the monitoring use case.

## Schedule and configuration

Starts the workflow on a timed interval and provides shared configuration values such as keywords, Slack webhook, and Google Sheet ID.

## Search Hacker News

Builds keyword-specific Hacker News search URLs, fetches the matching results, and flattens the returned hits into individual post items.

## Filter unseen posts

Loads the existing seen-URL log from Google Sheets and combines it with the fetched Hacker News items to keep only posts that have not been processed before.

## Summarize new posts

Sends each newly discovered Hacker News post to Groq to generate an AI summary for the alert.

## Alert and record

Posts the summarized alert to Slack, then saves the post to Google Sheets as seen to prevent duplicate future notifications.
